title: Your Quantization Format Is Not Free: Same-Size, Same-Label GGUF Files Decode Very Differently on Edge CPUs
description: Public artifact for the HotMobile 2027 submission "Your Quantization Format Is Not Free". Controlled measurements of GGUF quantization formats on three CPU microarchitectures (Cortex-A76, Gracemont, Golden Cove): a format label predicts poorly what a small-model GGUF file contains and costs, the community-default Q4_K_M is taxed on every core at 0.5B, and in randomized order the competitive 4-bit formats finish close together across the core types of one SoC. Includes raw measurement records, per-format quantization logs, runtime repack-coverage logs, PMIC energy, perplexity, control runs, and benchmark and figure code.
